title: Used In and Uses
responsibility: Shows what uses an entity and what that entity uses.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.relations
inputs.description: The relation lists of one entity, one per kind: pages and usedBy fill Used In, layouts, components, functions, configs, services, apis, models and types fill the Uses groups, and support fills the Other group. An absent apis, models or types list counts as empty, and when show is 'models' or 'apis', only the models or apis list is drawn.

usedBy.name: EntityRelations
usedBy.purpose: Shows what uses an entity and what that entity uses.

unit.title: Used In and Uses
unit.responsibility: Shows what uses an entity and what that entity uses.

verdict.label: Coverage incomplete
reasons: No scenario covers this unit; tests alone do not show how it behaves.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.host
inputs.description: The host props for the shown scope: lens supplies the relations of the cards and Other rows, entities and head are the consumers and revision the cards are read against, mediaBase is passed to the catalog items, and scope.commit is part of the key that resets the cards and groups. It is required and has no default.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.nav
inputs.description: The navigation of the shown entity: its route supplies the branch, commit, entity and helper that key the cards and groups, and the whole nav is passed to each catalog item. It is required and has no default.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.show
inputs.description: Selects which sections are drawn: 'both' draws Used In and Uses, 'used-in' and 'uses' each draw only their own section, and 'models' or 'apis' draw only the Models or APIs section. It defaults to 'both', and any value outside these five draws no section, only the empty container.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.removed
inputs.description: True when the shown commit removed the entity, so the empty message of each section drawn says it was removed at this commit. It defaults to false, which keeps the ordinary messages, and it changes no card or count.

outputs.name: EntityRelations
outputs.description: The markup of one ex-relations container holding what show selects: Used In and Uses for 'both', just Used In or just Uses for 'used-in' or 'uses', and just the Models or APIs section for 'models' or 'apis'. Each section shows its count and its entries through ExplorerCatalogItems with verification off, the Uses section adds an Other group when there are support entries, and an empty section shows its no-relations message, or the removed-at-this-commit wording when removed is true.
